title: Adapt All ID System Implementations to Updated Specs
prompt: Adapt all implementations and tests across Go, JS, TS, Python, C#, Rust and semio-repo CLI to the majorly updated ID system specs with entity-emoji-prefix format. Includes entity kinds, resource kinds, diffable entities, flat string slugging rules, and interaction support.
